name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.canon_take
typeText:
∀ (c : Nat) (l : List.{0} Bool) (hc : LE.le.{0} c (List.length.{0} l)),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Canon (List.take.{0} c l))
    (if h : LT.lt.{0} 0 c then GetElem.getElem.{0, 0, 0} l (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} c 1) ⋯ else Bool.true)

source.code:
theorem canon_take (c : ℕ) (l : List Bool) (hc : c ≤ l.length) :
    Canon (l.take c) = (if h : 0 < c then l[c - 1] else true) := by
  cases c with
  | zero => simp [Canon]
  | succ c =>
      simp only [Canon]
      rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?]
      simp only [List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left hc, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      rw [List.getElem?_take_of_lt (by omega), List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
      simp
